description: Finds Bible verses containing the given words in the World English Bible or the King James Version, ranked by how closely each verse matches. Common words are ignored, and a word also matches longer forms (fear matches fears and feared). Can be limited to one book or one testament.

book.description: Limit to one book, for example "Psalms" or "John".

limit.description: How many verses to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

query.description: Words to find, for example "do not be afraid" or "living water".

translation.description: Translation: "web" (World English Bible, the default) or "kjv" (King James Version).

name: search_scripture
title: Search scripture
